members.name: a
members.instructions: A customer sent this message to a digital bank's support chat. Which intent does the message express? Pick the single best-matching intent.

criteria.activate_my_card: Activating a card: how to activate a new card, or the activation is not working.
criteria.age_limit: Minimum age or age restrictions for opening or using an account, accounts for children/teens.
criteria.apple_pay_or_google_pay: Using the card or topping up with Apple Pay, Google Pay, Apple Watch or Android Pay; adding the card to them or it not working there.
criteria.atm_support: Finding ATMs, which ATMs accept the card, where the card can be used to withdraw cash.
criteria.automatic_top_up: The automatic / auto top-up feature: how it works, setting it up or turning it off.
criteria.balance_not_updated_after_bank_transfer: Money coming INTO the customer's own account here is not showing yet: moved from their UK account or another bank, or transferred to them. A 'UK account' transfer is the strong cue ('How long does a transfer from a UK account take? I just made one and it isn't showing', 'please check my UK account, I made the transfer a couple of hours ago').
criteria.balance_not_updated_after_cheque_or_cash: Money the customer deposited (a cheque, cash, or just 'deposited money') is not showing in the balance yet, or a cheque is slow to clear.
criteria.beneficiary_not_allowed: Cannot add a beneficiary or payee, or the beneficiary was rejected / not allowed.
criteria.cancel_transfer: Wants to cancel, stop or reverse a transfer or transaction they made (e.g. sent by mistake).
criteria.card_about_to_expire: The card is expiring or has expired; getting a replacement for an expiring card.
criteria.card_acceptance: Whether the card is accepted at shops/merchants or in places; where the card can be used for payments.
criteria.card_arrival: A card the customer ordered has not come yet: it was ordered days or weeks ago and still hasn't arrived (even if they also ask when to expect it), or tracking the card in the post.
criteria.card_delivery_estimate: When or how a new card will arrive, asked without saying it is overdue ('when will my card arrive?', 'how will I get my card?', 'when can I expect my card?'), delivery times, where cards can be delivered or shipped, expediting or choosing a delivery date.
criteria.card_linking: Linking or adding a card to the account or app, connecting a card that arrived, linking an existing card.
criteria.card_not_working: The card vaguely 'didn't work', 'wasn't working' or 'couldn't get it to work' (in a shop, several places or generally, but not at an ATM), without the words declined/rejected; also a broken or damaged card.
criteria.card_payment_fee_charged: A fee on card payments or card use, and vague complaints about hidden fees, too many fees, being charged fees without knowing why, or fees on payments ('why do some payments have fees', 'charged a fee, I thought it was free').
criteria.card_payment_not_recognised: A card payment or charge the customer does not recognise or did not make, e.g. 'a payment shows in my app that I didn't make'.
criteria.card_payment_wrong_exchange_rate: Complaints that an exchange rate received was wrong, bad or a rip-off when cash withdrawal is not mentioned (the default for rate complaints), incl. card purchases abroad, exchanging one currency for another and getting less than expected, and 'what was the rate on my last transaction'.
criteria.card_swallowed: An ATM kept, swallowed or retained the card; getting the card back ('help me retrieve my card').
criteria.cash_withdrawal_charge: Any fee for ATM cash withdrawals or getting cash, whether a question or a complaint.
criteria.cash_withdrawal_not_recognised: A cash withdrawal on the account that the customer did not make or does not recognise.
criteria.change_pin: Changing or updating an existing card PIN, or setting up a new PIN ('change' or 'new' PIN).
criteria.compromised_card: The card or its details may be compromised or used by someone else, fraud on the card, card details leaked (card not lost).
criteria.country_support: Which countries the bank or card is available or supported in; opening or using the account from a given country.
criteria.declined_card_payment: A card payment was explicitly declined, rejected or not accepted (the message says 'declined', 'rejected', 'not accepted', 'refused').
criteria.declined_cash_withdrawal: Getting cash at an ATM failed: the withdrawal was declined or not authorised, or the card won't work / couldn't get the ATM to work.
criteria.declined_transfer: A transfer the customer tried to make was declined or rejected.
criteria.direct_debit_payment_not_recognised: A direct debit on the account that the customer does not recognise or did not set up.
criteria.disposable_card_limits: Limits or restrictions of disposable virtual cards (how many uses, how many cards).
criteria.edit_personal_details: Changing personal details: name, address, phone number, email or other account information.
criteria.exchange_charge: Fees or charges for exchanging currency.
criteria.exchange_rate: Neutral questions about what the exchange rates are, where to see them, or how they are set, with no mention of cash or ATMs and no complaint about a rate received.
criteria.exchange_via_app: Exchanging currency in the app: how to do it, which currencies can be exchanged.
criteria.extra_charge_on_statement: A small extra charge of about £1 / $1 / €1 (one pound/dollar/euro more, extra pound) on the statement or account, even if it is pending or unrecognised.
criteria.failed_transfer: A transfer failed or did not go through, or the customer is unable to make a transfer.
criteria.fiat_currency_support: Which fiat currencies are supported for holding money or spending; whether a given currency is supported.
criteria.get_disposable_virtual_card: Getting or creating a disposable (single-use) virtual card.
criteria.get_physical_card: Questions about a card's PIN: finding, getting, receiving or setting up the PIN ('where is my PIN?', 'do I have a card PIN?', 'how do I get a PIN', 'set my physical card PIN', 'I can't find the PIN').
criteria.getting_spare_card: Getting an additional or spare card, a second card, a card for a family member.
criteria.getting_virtual_card: Getting or ordering a virtual card.
criteria.lost_or_stolen_card: The card has been lost or stolen.
criteria.lost_or_stolen_phone: The customer's phone was lost, stolen or left behind and they need access to the account or app.
criteria.order_physical_card: Getting or ordering a physical (plastic) card: how to get or order one, what it costs.
criteria.passcode_forgotten: Forgot the app passcode or login password; resetting the passcode.
criteria.pending_card_payment: A card payment or purchase the customer made is still pending or hasn't gone through yet ('why hasn't my payment gone through yet?', 'my purchase says pending').
criteria.pending_cash_withdrawal: A cash withdrawal is shown as pending.
criteria.pending_top_up: A top-up is still pending or taking long to show.
criteria.pending_transfer: The customer's own transfer is described as pending or still in progress, or they have been waiting a long time for their transfer to complete ('why is my transfer taking so long').
criteria.pin_blocked: The PIN or card is blocked after too many wrong PIN attempts; unblocking it.
criteria.receiving_money: How to receive money into the account: getting paid, receiving a salary or transfers from others, what details to give. Not incoming money that is missing or not showing (that is balance_not_updated_after_bank_transfer).
criteria.Refund_not_showing_up: A refund the customer is expecting has not shown up on the account yet.
criteria.request_refund: Requesting a refund for a purchase, or asking how refunds work.
criteria.reverted_card_payment?: A card payment that went through was reverted, returned or reversed, and the money came back.
criteria.supported_cards_and_currencies: Which cards (Visa, Mastercard, credit cards) and currencies are supported for topping up or for the account.
criteria.top_up_by_bank_transfer_charge: Fees or charges for topping up by bank transfer.
criteria.top_up_by_card_charge: Fees or charges for topping up with a debit or credit card.
criteria.top_up_by_cash_or_cheque: Topping up or depositing using cash or a cheque.
criteria.top_up_failed: A top-up failed or did not work.
criteria.top_up_limits: Limits on topping up: maximum or minimum top-up amounts, how much or how often one can top up.
criteria.top_up_reverted: A top-up (no card mentioned) went through or was attempted and then the money disappeared, was reverted, cancelled or returned ('top-up showed then disappeared', 'top-up still not working and I don't understand what happened to my money').
criteria.topping_up_by_card: Topping up with a card: how to do it, or a card top-up problem, including 'I topped up with my card and the money is gone/disappeared'.
criteria.transaction_charged_twice: The same transaction or payment was charged twice (duplicate charge).
criteria.transfer_fee_charged: A fee charged for a transfer; also bare 'why was I charged?' and 'will I get extra charges?' with nothing more specific.
criteria.transfer_into_account: How to transfer or add money into the account from another account or bank.
criteria.transfer_not_received_by_recipient: A transfer the customer made has not arrived where it was sent: 'I transferred some money but it is not here yet', a domestic transfer made days ago still not showing, or a friend, son, landlord or retailer hasn't received it (no UK-account-into-my-account cue).
criteria.transfer_timing: ONLY general questions about how long transfers take, with no specific stuck transfer of theirs; includes waiting for incoming money from the US or Europe ('how long does it take to get money from Europe?', 'waiting for a transfer from the US, how much longer?').
criteria.unable_to_verify_identity: The customer is having trouble or failing to verify their identity.
criteria.verify_my_identity: How to verify identity: the process, which documents are needed.
criteria.verify_source_of_funds: Verifying the source of funds; where the money in the account comes from.
criteria.verify_top_up: Verifying a top-up or the card used for top-up; the verification code for a top-up.
criteria.virtual_card_not_working: A virtual card is not working.
criteria.visa_or_mastercard: Visa vs Mastercard: whether the card is Visa or Mastercard, or wanting to get a Visa card or a Mastercard specifically.
criteria.why_verify_identity: Why the bank needs identity verification or personal information.
criteria.wrong_amount_of_cash_received: The ATM gave the wrong amount of cash, less than requested.
criteria.wrong_exchange_rate_for_cash_withdrawal: Any exchange-rate message that mentions getting cash or ATMs, even a neutral question ('what is the exchange rate when I get cash', 'exchange rate for foreign ATMs', 'should have been more cash'), or 'the rate was wrong when I was abroad' with no transaction type.

criteria.top_up_failed: A top-up failed or did not work.
criteria.top_up_reverted: A top-up (no card mentioned) went through or was attempted and then the money disappeared, was reverted, cancelled or returned ('top-up showed then disappeared', 'top-up still not working and I don't understand what happened to my money').
criteria.card_not_working: The card vaguely 'didn't work', 'wasn't working' or 'couldn't get it to work' (in a shop, several places or generally, but not at an ATM), without the words declined/rejected; also a broken or damaged card.
criteria.card_about_to_expire: The card is expiring or has expired; getting a replacement for an expiring card.
criteria.getting_virtual_card: Getting or ordering a virtual card.
criteria.declined_card_payment: A card payment was explicitly declined, rejected or not accepted (the message says 'declined', 'rejected', 'not accepted', 'refused').
criteria.transfer_fee_charged: A fee charged for a transfer; also bare 'why was I charged?' and 'will I get extra charges?' with nothing more specific.
criteria.unable_to_verify_identity: The customer is having trouble or failing to verify their identity.
criteria.country_support: Which countries the bank or card is available or supported in; opening or using the account from a given country.
criteria.disposable_card_limits: Limits or restrictions of disposable virtual cards (how many uses, how many cards).
criteria.exchange_via_app: Exchanging currency in the app: how to do it, which currencies can be exchanged.
criteria.verify_top_up: Verifying a top-up or the card used for top-up; the verification code for a top-up.
criteria.age_limit: Minimum age or age restrictions for opening or using an account, accounts for children/teens.
criteria.cancel_transfer: Wants to cancel, stop or reverse a transfer or transaction they made (e.g. sent by mistake).
criteria.top_up_limits: Limits on topping up: maximum or minimum top-up amounts, how much or how often one can top up.
criteria.pending_top_up: A top-up is still pending or taking long to show.
criteria.card_payment_not_recognised: A card payment or charge the customer does not recognise or did not make, e.g. 'a payment shows in my app that I didn't make'.
criteria.verify_my_identity: How to verify identity: the process, which documents are needed.
criteria.wrong_amount_of_cash_received: The ATM gave the wrong amount of cash, less than requested.
criteria.edit_personal_details: Changing personal details: name, address, phone number, email or other account information.
